15K likes, 261 comments - stephaniesanzo on October 26, 2026: "Things to remember for your next Back Workout 👇

✅ Use a balance of Different Movement Patterns
💡 Vertical Pulls for Back Width 💡 Horizontal Rows for Back Thickness & Shape

✅ Use both Bilateral & Unilateral Movements
💡 Bilateral for Strength & Size 💡 Unilateral for Activation & Symmetry

➖➖➖➖➖

Here’s a quick 4 movement session that puts it into practice…

↕️ VERTICAL PULLS
1. Chin Ups (Bilateral)
2. Single Arm Kneeling Pulldown (Unilateral)

↔️ HORIZONTAL ROWS 3. Seated Chest Supported Row (Bilateral) 4. Single Arm Machine Row (Unilateral)
SAVE this post and keep it as a reference for your next Pull Day 📝

OR .. if you’re looking to remove all the guesswork from training and want your workouts properly planned out for you…

Check out my app @liftit.app 📲

#backdayworkout #fitnesstip #exerciseroutine".
